events.outcome: The product and same-number extension path are current: 3GB annual entry is now ¥7,860 and the dedicated extension product is ¥5,400, with SMS reception and extension support explicitly listed.

data.acquisitionSummary: No-KYC 1-year prepaid SIM/eSIM on Rakuten Mobile network (+au partner + intl roaming) sold by calendar-world (株式会社CALENDAR) via jpsimshop / Rakuten marketplace / Amazon JP. 3GB/mo plan ¥5,980 new (community 2026-06 & 2026-08 agree); 6-month option from ¥3,300 (official shop page). First month free = up to 13 months on 1-year plan. eSIM delivered digitally (no Japan address needed); physical SIM ships Japan-only (forwarding required). SMS receive-only (can receive, cannot send); NO voice calls. Real JP 070/080/090 number.

keep.action: Before expiry, purchase the dedicated CALENDAR Rakuten-line extension for the existing assigned MSN/phone number. Current extension listing is ¥5,400.

data.chinaActivation: Yes — designed for it. Community-verified working from mainland China and Taiwan for SMS receiving: 2026-08 linux.do 9-country test scored 8/8 platforms (WhatsApp/Telegram/Google/Apple ID/PayPal/Instagram/TikTok/Amazon); V2EX OP used it in China for eplus/pia ticket registration (2023 thread, re-confirmed 2025-09). Activate by inserting eSIM/SIM with roaming on.
data.kyc: None for direct purchase — it is a data+SMS-receive product, not a voice service, so it sits outside Japan's voice-KYC regime (tightened 2026-04 per fluctlight tracker).
data.payment: Credit card (extension flow is card-only). Community reports some Visa/Mastercard BINs fail on purchase — retry with another card.
data.wifiCalling: not applicable — no voice service on this product
data.roamingSms: Official listing: overseas SMS receiving supported (海外でのSMS受信も可能). Abuse clause: malicious SMS use can get ALL functions permanently stopped by the carrier. Roaming data 1GB/mo on 3GB plan, 128kbps after cap; community measured ~400ms latency from China (Rakuten routes roaming via Orange/France).
data.refund: not reconciled — shop page says unsupported-device use is non-refundable
data.tariffSummary: Current 3GB annual physical SIM starts at ¥7,860; SMS reception is supported; dedicated physical/eSIM extension is ¥5,400 for eligible CALENDAR Rakuten-line plans.
guideSteps: Buy the 1-year 3GB eSIM plan from jpsimshop / Rakuten marketplace / Amazon JP (~¥5,980). Choose eSIM to skip Japan-only shipping.
Install eSIM, enable roaming; SMS receiving works abroad immediately. Do not abuse SMS (carrier can kill all functions).
Calendar the expiry: shop SMS-notices ~2 months before; extension order+payment must complete by the 15th 14:00 JST of expiry month (¥5,400, same number, remote).
